title: Viññāṇam
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave cakkhuviññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 4-8 Yo sotaviññāṇasmiṃ || Yo ghānaviññāṇasmiṃ || Yo jivhāviññāṇasmiṃ || Yo kāyaviññānasmiṃ || Yo manoviññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 9 Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti || nekkhammaninnaṃ cassa cittaṃ hoti nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃkammaniyaṃ khāyati abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti [page 233] XXVII. 7. 4-8] KILESA-SAṂYUTTA 233 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || ||
